effective_period: Week of Monday, 21 September 2026 – Friday, 25 September 2026

policies.title: Password Reset
policies.summary: Employees can reset password via self-service portal. Locked out after 5 failed attempts requires manual IT unlock. No approval required.
policies.full_text: Employees can reset their own password via the self-service portal at any time. If locked out after 5 failed attempts, contact IT to unlock the account manually. No approval required.
policies.sla: Immediate self-service / Within 1 business hour manual unlock

policies.title: VPN Access
policies.summary: Full-time employees receive VPN access automatically. Contractors require manager approval via access request form. Credentials expire every 90 days and require employee renewal.
policies.full_text: VPN access is granted automatically to all full-time employees. Contractors require manager approval submitted via the access request form. VPN credentials expire every 90 days and must be renewed by the employee.
policies.approval_conditions: Contractors require manager approval submitted via access request form; Full-time employees require no approval.
policies.sla: Immediate renewal self-service / 1-2 business days for contractor requests

policies.title: Laptop Replacement
policies.summary: Laptops eligible after 3 years of service, or earlier in case of verified hardware failure. Must be raised at least 2 weeks in advance.
policies.full_text: Laptops are eligible for replacement after 3 years of service, or earlier in case of verified hardware failure. Requests must be raised at least 2 weeks in advance of intended replacement.
policies.approval_conditions: Verified hardware failure or standard 3-year threshold reached. Cross-reference with Finance Asset Management Policy (Q2 2026) for refresh cycle sign-offs.
policies.sla: 2 weeks lead time for replacement fulfillment

policies.title: Software Installation Requests
policies.summary: Standard catalog software can be self-installed. Non-catalog software requires IT Security review (3–5 business days).
policies.full_text: Standard software (listed in the approved catalog) can be self-installed. Non-catalog software requires IT Security review, which takes 3–5 business days.
policies.approval_conditions: IT Security review required for all non-catalog software and browser extensions.

policies.title: Printer Troubleshooting
policies.summary: For printer issues, check printer queue and restart print spooler. If issue persists, log ticket with printer asset tag.
policies.full_text: For printer issues, first check the printer queue and restart the print spooler. If the issue persists after restart, log a ticket with the printer’s asset tag.

policies.title: Email Mailbox Quota
policies.summary: Default mailbox quota is 25GB. Employees nearing quota should archive old mail. Quota increases beyond 25GB require manager approval and are capped at 50GB.
policies.full_text: Default mailbox quota is 25GB. Employees nearing quota should archive old mail. Quota increases beyond 25GB require manager approval and are capped at 50GB.
policies.approval_conditions: Manager approval required for increases beyond 25GB.

policies.title: Guest Wi-Fi Access
policies.summary: Guest Wi-Fi credentials valid for 24 hours. Generated by any employee from front-desk kiosk. No IT ticket required.
policies.full_text: Guest Wi-Fi credentials are valid for 24 hours and can be generated by any employee from the front-desk kiosk. No IT ticket required.

policies.title: Expense Software Access
policies.summary: Access to expense management tool granted by Finance, not IT. IT can only assist with login/technical issues once an account exists.
policies.full_text: Access to the expense management tool is granted by Finance, not IT. IT can only assist with login/technical issues once an account already exists.
policies.sla: Finance SLA for account creation; IT assists with credentials if account exists

policies.title: Security Incident Reporting
policies.summary: Suspected phishing, malware, or unauthorized access must be reported immediately to security@veridian-corp.example and NOT forwarded to other employees.
policies.full_text: Any suspected phishing email, malware, or unauthorized access attempt must be reported to security@veridian-corp.example immediately and should not be forwarded to other employees.
policies.critical_instruction: Strictly do not forward suspected emails to colleagues or other employees.

policies.title: Work-From-Home Equipment
policies.summary: Employees working remotely >3 days/week eligible for one-time home office equipment allowance (chair, monitor). Requires manager sign-off and Finance processing. IT handles shipping once approved.
policies.full_text: Employees working remotely more than 3 days/week are eligible for a one-time home office equipment allowance (chair, monitor). Requires manager sign-off and Finance processing — IT only handles the equipment shipping request once approved.
policies.sla: Shipped within 5 business days after Finance approval

policies.title: Asset Management Policy (Extract)
policies.summary: Standard 4-year refresh cycle for all company-issued hardware (laptops, monitors). Early replacement outside this cycle requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval.
policies.full_text: All company-issued hardware, including laptops and monitors, follows a standard 4-year refresh cycle from date of issue. Early replacement outside this cycle requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval.
policies.early_replacement_rule: Requires Finance sign-off in addition to IT approval
policies.sla: Standard quarterly or milestone refresh / Custom Finance review for early replacement
